notes.title: Patch 1.1 for Robots at Midnight is officially live!
notes.content:
Patch 1.1 is Live! New Settings, Fixes, Languages & More 


Hi everyone,



This update brings a wave of community-requested improvements, new features, and expanded language support to make your journey through Yob even smoother and more immersive. Whether you’re here for the story or the challenge, there’s something new for everyone.


Game Modes: Play Your Way
Patch 1.1 introduces the ability to switch between difficulty settings mid-game without losing your progress. You can now swap freely between:

Hero Mode: Experience the action and story at an approachable pace

Master Mode: For players prepared to face a challenge 

Whether you’re finding things too easy or hitting a difficulty spike, this change lets you adjust on the fly without starting over. Just head to the Options Menu at any time to choose your preferred challenge level.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743987/b2aa448013c17b269f889a2581e312e0c34aaebc.png"]
New Language Support
We’re excited to welcome even more players into Robots at Midnight:

Russian, Turkish, and Ukrainian are now fully supported!

Translation polish and typo fixes across all supported languages

Updated achievement translations for clarity


Visual Settings & Brightness Tuning
We’ve added more options to help you customize your visual experience:

Toggle Volumetric Fog

Adjust Bloom and Ambient Occlusion

Updated lookup tables for improved tone and color balance

Brightness tweaks in early-game areas to enhance visibility

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeumxO5-bbkqVJoXDxCEVzbGPY8uTkn6mFLkPPYRbpawR7SJQqMJg7HWm6UrdKVMJ0oDm_e2hdpyKssCK0SnTDMW4z4fFQwsOCPdDVAms9BXH_zJBj8LqMsUZ9nxjY6FH1U2hg?key=lxllMb9Z8FuDyB9U3UmF3A"]
Quest Fixes & Inventory Glitches
Fixes include:

Quest items are now visible from greater distances


Additional Quality of Life Updates
Game Mode selection UI updated for clarity

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdTlxC7dX4goMyEJb9gESHrTtp7q0-U2uLiv_CUA_Y0jQCmGU2JDuf4U3ovT941OMRzSj1fly6-3aDYYAT4jv7uq87c6pWrbESNEFEEw_SNdvfAiCyf8pFX1CcmIyq0cmDXHYh3?key=lxllMb9Z8FuDyB9U3UmF3A"]

Unlock icon now appears on the main menu after completing the game

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743987/b280a1516bc90162fec1e6814b70ce2ccf0ff55c.png"]

Various under-the-hood stability and performance improvements


Thank YouTo everyone who’s joined us since launch: thank you for playing, sharing, and supporting Robots at Midnight. Your feedback is helping us build a better game with every patch! Stay tuned for future updates! 

Don't forget to join us on Discord!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743987/f3404c00d1c29bba26f66d59c66052aebbb0b899.gif"]

notes.title: Robots at Midnight Fan Art Showdown Community Contest
notes.content:
⚙️ Rise of the Machines ⚙️ 
Robots at Midnight Fan Art ShowdownA fan art contest set on the planet Yob, home of Robots at Midnight


The machine uprising has begun on Yob — a brutal, post-collapse planet where humanity’s last survivors fight for control against rogue AI and cybernetic war machines.



Your mission: Create fan art that brings the world of Robots at Midnight to life. You can draw one of the characters from the game or design your own robot, scavenger, or survivor that feels like it belongs on the planet Yob.



Your art can be hand-drawn, digital, or animated (gif) — whatever style you choose, make it look like it fits in the retro-futuristic world of Robots at Midnight.

Submission Details:
All entries must be submitted via the Steam Community Artwork tab for Robots at Midnight. Here’s how to enter:
[olist]
Create your art – Submit fan art of a character from Robots at Midnight or design your own original robot, scavenger, or tech-infused survivor that fits within the retro-futuristic world of Yob. All visual formats are welcome:

Hand-drawn

Digital illustration

Animation (gif)

Upload your piece to Steam by July 20, 2025:

Visit the Robots at Midnight Steam page

Go to the Community Hub > Artwork tab

Click Upload Artwork

Title your post: Rise of the Machines - {Your Character’s Name}

Make sure your artwork is set to public so the community and dev team can view and vote!
[/olist]

Prizes[table equalcells="1" colwidth="196,"][tr][td colwidth="196"]
Placement
[/td][td]
Reward
[/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="196"]
🥇 1st Place
[/td][td]
$100 Steam Gift Card + Merch Pack + Social Feature + Arduino Engineering Kit 
[/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="196"]
🥈 2nd Place
[/td][td]
$50 Steam Gift Card + Merch Pack + Social Feature + Mini Synthesizer 
[/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="196"]
⭐ Fan Favorite
[/td][td]
Merch Pack + Social Spotlight + Makey Makey Classic
[/td][/tr][/table]

Submission Rules[olist]
Stick to the Theme – Your art must be inspired by Robots at Midnight. You can draw a game character or create your own robot, scavenger, or survivor that fits the world of Yob.

Keep it in Style – Your art should look like it belongs in the Robots at Midnight universe (retro-futuristic, gritty, and sci-fi). 

Original Art Only – All artwork must be created by you. No tracing, copying, or using AI tools.

Formats Allowed – Must be JPG, PNG, or GIF. Hand-drawn, digital art, and animated GIFs are welcome!

Be Kind and Clean – Your submission should be appropriate for all ages. No violence, gore, or inappropriate content.

Sign Your Art – Add your name or username in the corner of your artwork. No big logos or watermarks, please!

Submit on Steam – Upload your art to the Robots at Midnight Steam Community Artwork tab. Title it like this: Rise of the Machines - {Your Character’s Name}

Make it Public – Set your submission to Public so the dev team and the community can see and vote on it!

Submit on Time – The deadline is July 20, 2025. Don’t miss it!

Have fun! 
[/olist]


Join us on discord to find out more!

notes.title: Robots at Midnight is Now Available on Steam!
notes.content:
Cryo-sleep is over.

Awaken as Zoe, a young hero thrust into the perilous wasteland of Yob- a planet that was once a thriving luxury destination, now reduced to ruins crawling with corrupted machines and buried secrets. With only her MITT gauntlet and a floating admin droid named Phlite, Zoe must fight to survive, uncover the truth behind The Blackout, and find her missing father.Robots at Midnight is a retro-futuristic action-adventure that blends momentum-driven combat, atmospheric exploration, and rich world-building. 

Survive, adapt, and get home before midnight.

[previewyoutube="2q9Nk64jxqc;full"][/previewyoutube]



Cryo-sleep was the easy part. It's time to begin the hard one: 
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2623040/Robots_at_Midnight/"][/dynamiclink]

notes.content:
Cryo-sleep ends at midnight on June 19, 2025, and your journey across the desolate landscapes of Yob — a world left in ruins and haunted by the machines once built to serve it — begins.

Battle corrupted machines, uncover hidden lore, and search for your missing father in this retro-futuristic action RPG.
